turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m a 31-year-old woman, and I’ve had intermittent flank pain for about five months. Over the past two years I’ve had five urinary tract infections, but recently I haven’t had fever, nausea, or vomiting, and my urinary habits are mostly unchanged except during those infections.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any small raised bumps on my skin or any “dimples” in the center. I haven’t had any new rash either.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed increased frequency or urgency recently—my urinary habits are mostly the same, except when I’m having a UTI.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I haven’t felt generally weak or lacking my usual strength. I’ve been able to do my normal activities, and I’m not experiencing any new systemic symptoms.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself or putting on your clothes lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any trouble dressing myself or putting on my clothes, and I haven’t noticed any new weakness or trouble with my usual activities.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms.” “I mainly just have the intermittent flank pain, without any new skin changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any itchiness on my skin, and I haven’t noticed any new rash or skin changes—just the intermittent flank pain.

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calf muscles when you walk that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any calf pain or cramping when I walk, and it doesn’t change with rest. I’ve mainly just had the intermittent flank pain over the past five months.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any change in my stool color—nothing pale or clay-colored. My bowel habits have been pretty normal, and I haven’t had any nausea or vomiting either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any weakness in my hands—gripping objects and opening jars feels the same as usual.

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I haven’t had any shaking episodes or loss of consciousness—I’m mainly dealing with intermittent flank pain. I’ve stayed aware and able to recognize my surroundings the whole time.
